rules.statement: A sale by a judgment debtor or his heirs is void if it occurs after the seizure and registration of the notice of seizure, but not registered. If the seizure is not registered, the necessary implication is that a bona fide private alienee is statim securus.
rules.supporting_quote: "If the seizure is not registered, the necessary implication of section 238 is that a bona fide private alienee is statim securus. I think that section 289, as regards relation back, must be read in the light of section 238"
